items.title: Phillips 66 (PSX) Secures Long Term Used Cooking Oil Supply For Renewable Fuels
items.summary: Phillips 66 (NYSE: PSX) agreed to a long-term deal with Restaurant Technologies to turn used cooking oil into renewable fuels at its Rodeo Renewable Energy Complex. The partnership sources used cooking oil from U.S. restaurants as domestic feedstock for sustainable aviation fuel and renewable diesel production.
